statement: For any elliptic curve punctured at at least two geometric points, the full geometric abelian Selmer fibre over a rational compact point is the unique point section when the centre is interior, and the complete injectively parametrized completed-Kummer cusp packet when the centre is a rational boundary point.
depends_on: Full compact local Kummer injectivity; completed multiplicative Kummer local-global injection with explicit dyadic proof; inflation-restriction for lattices splitting into cyclotomic copies; boundary homology sequence
answers: A.12 and Lead5: exact abelian Selmer fibres over every integer surviving A.63; general compact-point fibre rigidity beyond the rank-zero application in B.26
notes: The proof supplies an elementary Chebotarev argument at odd coefficient primes. At2 it restricts to F(i), uses cyclic cyclotomic groups, then restriction-corestriction and the locally injective roots-of-unity torsion subgroup. For any split Tate lattice the global-local injection follows by finite splitting field restriction, since geometric invariants vanish. Applied to W_D and W_D/I_B, this determines all fibres and proves packet injectivity. Only finite-place Selmerness is used; no incorrect real local disjointness is asserted. The at-least-two-boundary-points hypothesis is explicit because one-puncture abelianization kills cusp inertia. No metabelian fibre classification is inferred.
